title: 实验 5-16 · I²C 上拉电阻怎么选：上升时间 = R × 总线电容
summary: Blue Pill 的两个开漏引脚以 100 kHz 模拟两条 I²C 线，各挂 200 pF 总线电容，一条用 10 kΩ 上拉、一条用 2.2 kΩ。用示波器的上升 / 下降时间读数对照 I²C 规范，再算出上拉电阻的下限（灌电流 3 mA）。
concepts: I²C 上拉电阻 I²C pull-up
description: **目标**：看 I²C 这类开漏总线的上升沿怎样由上拉电阻和总线电容决定（τ = R·C），并学会按 I²C 规范选上拉电阻的阻值范围。
**电路**：Blue Pill 插在 c1，USB 供电。下排 3V3（j20）→ bp 轨，GND（j19）→ bn 轨。用两个能输出 PWM 的引脚（参考答案用 I²C1 的 **PB6 / PB7**，g14 / g15）当两条“总线”：
- 总线 A：PB6 → RA **10 kΩ** 上拉到 3V3，CA **200 pF** 到 GND；
- 总线 B：PB7 → RB **2.2 kΩ** 上拉到 3V3，CB **200 pF** 到 GND。
200 pF 代表真实总线上的电容：每个 I²C 器件的引脚约 10 pF，每 10 cm 走线 / 杜邦线约 5–10 pF，加上示波器探头，几个模块 + 一段线很容易到 100–200 pF（规范上限 400 pF）。示波器 CH1 接总线 A，CH2 接总线 B。
**引脚设置**：两个引脚都设成 **PWM 输出 + 开漏**（`{ "mode": "pwm", "duty": 50, "frequency": 100000, "openDrain": true }`），用 100 kHz 方波代替 I²C 的 SCL 时钟。测试也会改成 400 kHz，或者静态的“开漏输出低 / 松开”。
- 10 % → 90 %：t = RC × ln 9 ≈ **2.197·RC**（示波器的“上升时间”读数测的就是这个）；
- 规范上限：标准模式（100 kHz）t_r ≤ **1000 ns**，快速模式（400 kHz）t_r ≤ **300 ns**。换算成 10–90 %：约 2.59 µs 和 0.78 µs。
**先预测**：两条总线的 τ 各是多少？10–90 % 上升时间和规范的 t_r（30–70 %）各是多少，分别满不满足标准模式和快速模式？100 kHz 的半个周期（5 µs）和 400 kHz 的半个周期（1.25 µs）里，10 kΩ 的总线能爬到多高，够不够 STM32 的 VIH（2.15 V）？输出低电平时两条总线各灌多少电流（引脚 N 管约 40 Ω）？
- **上升时间**（rise time，10 % → 90 %）：开漏引脚“松开”后，只能靠上拉电阻给总线电容充电，τ = R·C；
- **下降时间 fall**：引脚导通时由 N 管（约 40 Ω）直接放电，非常快；
- 高电平最高到多少（vmax）：上升太慢时，电平在下一个下降沿之前**根本爬不到** VIH；
- 输出低电平时的**灌电流**和 V_OL：上拉电阻太小，引脚拉不低。
电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**怎么选上拉电阻**：
- **上限**（够快）：R_max = t_r / (0.8473 × C_bus)。200 pF 时标准模式 R_max ≈ 5.9 kΩ，快速模式 R_max ≈ **1.77 kΩ**（用 1.5 kΩ）。
- **下限**（拉得低）：I²C 规范要求器件在灌 **3 mA** 时 V_OL ≤ **0.4 V**，所以 R_min = (3.3 V − 0.4 V) / 3 mA ≈ **967 Ω**（5 V 总线为 1.53 kΩ）。
**内部上拉不够用**：STM32 约 40 kΩ、ESP32 约 45 kΩ，200 pF 时 τ ≈ 8–9 µs，比 100 kHz 的整个周期还长。它们只能让单个模块在很短的线上“勉强能跑”，正式电路一定要外接上拉。
**实际项目经验**：
- 很多 I²C 模块板上**已经带了**上拉（常见 4.7 kΩ 或 10 kΩ）。挂 5 个这样的模块，总上拉就是 4.7 kΩ / 5 ≈ 940 Ω——已经低于下限，低电平拉不下去。挂多个模块时要拆掉多余的上拉。
- 杜邦线越长电容越大，超过 30–50 cm 就容易出错；长线用更低的频率、更小的上拉，或者 I²C 缓冲芯片（P82B715、PCA9515）。
- 上拉接 **3.3 V**，不要接 5 V：ESP32 的引脚都不耐 5 V；STM32 只有 FT 引脚（PB6 / PB7 是）耐 5 V。和 5 V 器件通信用电平转换（BSS138 双向电平转换模块）。
- ESP32 的 I²C 可以用任意 GPIO，但避开 GPIO34–39（只能输入）、GPIO6–11（Flash）和启动配置引脚；默认是 GPIO21（SDA）/ GPIO22（SCL）。
- 总线“卡死”（SDA 一直是低）时先看上拉和电平，再看从机是否在复位中途被打断。
**模型说明**：引脚的开漏 N 管是 40 Ω 的理想开关，没有输出电容；电容和电阻是理想的；时域仿真每个周期 256 步（100 kHz 时 39 ns 一步），所以 fall 只能分辨到几十 ns，波形底部有几十 mV 的数值下冲；这里只用方波模拟 SCL，没有真正的 I²C 协议。

en.title: Experiment 5-16 · Choosing I²C pull-ups: rise time = R × bus capacitance
en.summary: Two open-drain Blue Pill pins toggle at 100 kHz as two I²C lines, each with 200 pF of bus capacitance — one pulled up with 10 kΩ, one with 2.2 kΩ. Compare the scope's rise and fall times with the I²C spec and work out the lower limit of the pull-up (3 mA sink current).
description: **Goal**: see how the rising edge of an open-drain bus such as I²C is set by the pull-up resistor and the bus capacitance (τ = R·C), and learn to pick the pull-up range from the I²C spec.
**Circuit**: a Blue Pill at c1 on USB. Lower-row 3V3 (j20) → bp rail, GND (j19) → bn rail. Two PWM-capable pins (the solution uses I²C1's **PB6 / PB7**, g14 / g15) are two "buses":
- bus A: PB6 → RA **10 kΩ** pull-up to 3V3, CA **200 pF** to GND;
- bus B: PB7 → RB **2.2 kΩ** pull-up to 3V3, CB **200 pF** to GND.

The 200 pF stands for the real bus capacitance: about 10 pF per I²C device pin, about 5–10 pF per 10 cm of trace / jumper wire, plus the scope probe — a few modules and a bit of wire easily reach 100–200 pF (the spec limit is 400 pF). Scope CH1 on bus A, CH2 on bus B.

**Pin table settings**: set both pins to **PWM output + open drain** (`{ "mode": "pwm", "duty": 50, "frequency": 100000, "openDrain": true }`): a 100 kHz square wave in place of the I²C SCL clock. The tests also use 400 kHz, and static "open-drain LOW / released".
**Formulas**: the charging curve is V(t) = 3.3 V × (1 − e^(−t/RC)).
- 10 % → 90 %: t = RC × ln 9 ≈ **2.197·RC** (what the scope's rise-time reading measures);
- the I²C spec's t_r is **30 % → 70 %**: t = RC × ln(7/3) ≈ **0.8473·RC**, about 0.386 × the 10–90 % time;
- spec limits: Standard mode (100 kHz) t_r ≤ **1000 ns**, Fast mode (400 kHz) t_r ≤ **300 ns**. In 10–90 % terms that is about 2.59 µs and 0.78 µs.

**Predict first**: what is τ for each bus? What are the 10–90 % rise time and the spec's t_r (30–70 %), and does each bus meet Standard mode and Fast mode? Within half a 100 kHz period (5 µs) and half a 400 kHz period (1.25 µs), how high does the 10 kΩ bus get — enough for the STM32's VIH (2.15 V)? How much current does each bus sink in output LOW (the pin's N-channel transistor is about 40 Ω)?
**Measure**:
- **rise time** (10 % → 90 %): once the open-drain pin lets go, only the pull-up charges the bus capacitance, τ = R·C;
- **fall time**: when the pin conducts, its N-channel transistor (about 40 Ω) discharges the bus directly — very fast;
- the highest level reached (vmax): if the rise is too slow, the line **never reaches** VIH before the next falling edge;
- the **sink current** and V_OL in output LOW: with too small a pull-up the pin can't pull the line low.
Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.
**Choosing the pull-up**:
- **Upper limit** (fast enough): R_max = t_r / (0.8473 × C_bus). At 200 pF, Standard mode R_max ≈ 5.9 kΩ, Fast mode R_max ≈ **1.77 kΩ** (use 1.5 kΩ).
- **Lower limit** (can pull low): the I²C spec only guarantees V_OL ≤ **0.4 V** while sinking **3 mA**, so R_min = (3.3 V − 0.4 V) / 3 mA ≈ **967 Ω** (1.53 kΩ on a 5 V bus).
- So for 3.3 V, 100 kHz and a few modules: **2.2–4.7 kΩ**; for 400 kHz or long wires: **1–2.2 kΩ**.

**Internal pull-ups are too weak**: about 40 kΩ (STM32) or 45 kΩ (ESP32) gives τ ≈ 8–9 µs at 200 pF — longer than a whole 100 kHz period. They only make a single module on very short wires "sort of work"; a real design needs external pull-ups.
**Rule of thumb for real projects**:

- Many I²C breakout boards **already have** pull-ups (often 4.7 kΩ or 10 kΩ). Five such modules in parallel give 4.7 kΩ / 5 ≈ 940 Ω — below the lower limit, and the low level no longer gets low enough. Remove the extra pull-ups when you hang several modules on one bus.
- Longer jumper wires mean more capacitance; beyond 30–50 cm errors start. For long runs use a lower clock, smaller pull-ups, or an I²C buffer (P82B715, PCA9515).
- Pull up to **3.3 V**, not 5 V: no ESP32 pin is 5 V tolerant, and on an STM32 only the FT pins are (PB6 / PB7 are). To talk to 5 V parts use a level shifter (the BSS138 bidirectional module).
- ESP32 I²C can use any GPIO, but avoid GPIO34–39 (input-only), GPIO6–11 (flash) and the strapping pins; the default is GPIO21 (SDA) / GPIO22 (SCL).
- When the bus "hangs" (SDA stuck low), check the pull-ups and levels first, then whether a slave was interrupted mid-transfer by a reset.

**Model note**: the open-drain N-channel transistor is an ideal 40 Ω switch with no output capacitance; R and C are ideal; the time-domain simulation uses 256 steps per period (39 ns per step at 100 kHz), so fall is only resolved to a few tens of ns and the bottom of the waveform shows a few tens of mV of numerical undershoot; the square wave only imitates SCL — there is no real I²C protocol.
compare: - **2.2 kΩ, 100 kHz**: τ = 440 ns, rise (10–90 %) = **0.97 µs** (2.2 × 2.2 kΩ × 200 pF = 0.97 µs), i.e. t_r(30–70 %) ≈ 373 ns: meets Standard mode, **fails** Fast mode (> 300 ns). The high level reaches 3.30 V. fall < 0.1 µs (limited by the time step; really about 2.2 × 40 Ω × 200 pF ≈ 18 ns).

- **10 kΩ, 100 kHz**: τ = 2 µs; half a period (5 µs) is only 2.5τ, so the high level only climbs to **3.03 V**. The scope's rise ≈ **3.3 µs** (measured on the actual swing; the full exponential is 4.4 µs), t_r(30–70 %) ≈ 1.7 µs — **not even Standard mode**.

- **400 kHz**: the half period is 1.25 µs. Bus A (10 kΩ) only reaches **1.54 V**, below the STM32's VIH (2.15 V) and I²C's 0.7·VDD (2.31 V): the other side always reads 0 and communication fails completely. Bus B (2.2 kΩ) reaches 3.11 V — it limps along, but its edges are out of spec.
- **Output LOW**: with 2.2 kΩ the sink current is 3.3 V / (2.2 kΩ + 40 Ω) ≈ **1.47 mA** and V_OL ≈ **59 mV**; with 10 kΩ only 0.33 mA.

measurements.ask: 100 kHz: bus B's (2.2 kΩ) rise time t_r (10% → 90%)
400 kHz: the highest voltage bus A (10 kΩ) reaches
measurements.explain: Half a period, 1.25 µs, is only about 0.6τ: it climbs to about 1.5 V — below the STM32's VIH (2.15 V), so the other side always reads 0.

measurements.ask: I²C Fast mode needs t_r(30–70%) ≤ 300 ns (about ≤ 0.78 µs for 10–90%). From your readings:
choices: Only bus B (2.2 kΩ) meets it
measurements.explain: Bus B's 0.97 µs is above 0.78 µs too; at 200 pF Fast mode needs a pull-up ≤ 1.77 kΩ (use 1.5 kΩ).

hints: Each bus: GPIO → pull-up resistor → 3V3, and the 200 pF capacitor from the same GPIO to GND.
Bus A gets 10 kΩ, bus B gets 2.2 kΩ.
Set both pins to PWM, 100 kHz, 50 %, and tick open drain.
tests: 100 kHz, bus B (2.2 kΩ): rise time meets Standard mode, reaches 3.3 V, fast fall
100 kHz, bus A (10 kΩ): too slow a rise, never reaches 3.3 V
400 kHz: bus A never reaches VIH
Open-drain LOW: bus B sinks ≈ 1.47 mA at V_OL ≈ 59 mV, bus A ≈ 0.33 mA — both under 3 mA
Released (open-drain HIGH): the pull-ups hold both lines at 3.3 V

tests.name: 100 kHz、总线 B（2.2 kΩ）：上升时间满足标准模式，到 3.3 V，下降很快
100 kHz、总线 A（10 kΩ）：上升太慢，高电平到不了 3.3 V
400 kHz：总线 A 爬不到 VIH
开漏输出低电平：总线 B 灌 ≈ 1.47 mA、V_OL ≈ 59 mV，总线 A ≈ 0.33 mA——都在 3 mA 以内
松开（开漏输出高）：上拉把两条线都拉到 3.3 V

compare: - **10 kΩ，100 kHz**：τ = 2 µs，半个周期 5 µs 只有 2.5τ，高电平只爬到 **3.03 V**；示波器测的 rise ≈ **3.3 µs**（按实际摆幅算；完整指数曲线是 4.4 µs），t_r(30–70 %) ≈ 1.7 µs —— **连标准模式都不满足**。
- **400 kHz**：半周期 1.25 µs，10 kΩ 的总线 A 只爬到 **1.54 V**，低于 STM32 的 VIH（2.15 V）和 I²C 的 0.7·VDD（2.31 V），对方读到的永远是 0——通信完全失败；2.2 kΩ 的总线 B 爬到 3.11 V，勉强能用但边沿不合规。

measurements.ask: 100 kHz：总线 B（2.2 kΩ）的上升时间 t_r（10% → 90%）
400 kHz：总线 A（10 kΩ）能爬到的最高电压
measurements.explain: 半个周期 1.25 µs 只有约 0.6τ，只能爬到约 1.5 V——低于 STM32 的 VIH（2.15 V），对方永远读到 0。

choices: 只有 2.2 kΩ 的总线 B 满足
measurements.ask: I²C 快速模式要求 t_r(30–70%) ≤ 300 ns（约等于 10–90% 时间 ≤ 0.78 µs）。按你测的读数：
measurements.explain: 总线 B 的 0.97 µs 也超过了 0.78 µs；200 pF 时快速模式的上拉要 ≤ 1.77 kΩ（用 1.5 kΩ）。

hints: 每条总线：GPIO → 上拉电阻 → 3V3，同一个 GPIO 再接 200 pF 电容到 GND。
总线 A 用 10 kΩ，总线 B 用 2.2 kΩ。
两个引脚都设成 PWM、100 kHz、50 %，并勾选开漏。
